subject.title: feat: Add Netbird VPN support and fix Tailscale auto-connect

question: Should this installer support NetBird as a first-class core VPN provider, or should the work be limited to the existing Tailscale contract until that provider boundary is explicitly sponsored?
rationale: Adding a third-party VPN repository, setup-key flow, firewall behavior, and sudo permission surface is a persistent product and security boundary beyond a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor NetBird with safeguards
options.body: Keep the provider feature, but require legacy-Tailscale compatibility, trusted repository-key handling review, and disposable-host proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Tailscale repair
options.body: Split out the NetBird feature and submit a focused Tailscale fix that preserves current configuration behavior and correctly detects `NeedsLogin`.

recommendation.title: Sponsor NetBird with safeguards
recommendation.body: Keep the provider feature, but require legacy-Tailscale compatibility, trusted repository-key handling review, and disposable-host proof before merge.
